title: Multi-Angle Product Packshot Photos | AIVideosUGC
description: Make clean packshot photos of the same product from the front, side, back, and top. Keep a consistent white backdrop for listings, galleries, and ads.
lead: Show the product you sell from the front, side, back, and top on a clean white backdrop. Upload the side you want to show so its details stay true.

steps.d: Upload a clear photo of each product side you need. Keep the whole item in frame and the lighting even.
Name the view and request the same plain backdrop. Use the photo of that side when buttons or ports must stay accurate.
Download each square packshot and add it to your listing or gallery. Check every view against the product you ship.

faq.q: What is a multi-angle product packshot?
faq.a: It is a clean product photo from one side. Make matching front, side, back, and top views for your gallery.

faq.q: How do I make a matching set of product views?
faq.a: Upload each side you have photographed, name the view, and use the same white backdrop for every square photo.

faq.q: Why use these photos instead of another shoot?
faq.a: You can build consistent listing views from photos you already have without resetting the studio for each side.
Shops and listing teams use them when buyers need to inspect the shape, controls, openings, or base before ordering.

faq.q: Can I make packshots without editing experience?
faq.a: Yes. Upload a clear product photo, choose the view, and download the square image after you check its details.

faq.q: Which products work for multi-angle packshots?
faq.a: Mugs, bags, lamps, gadgets, and other physical goods benefit when shoppers need to see more than the front.

faq.q: Can I use photos I already took?
faq.a: Yes. Use your own clear photos of each side. Photograph any side that contains a detail you need to show accurately.

faq.q: Where can I use the finished photos?
faq.a: Use the square views in product galleries, marketplaces, social posts, and ads. Check each channel’s current image rules.

faq.q: How many credits does a packshot use?
faq.a: Each product photo costs 24 credits. You see the cost before generating a view, and a failed job returns its credits.

faq.q: Can I use the product photos in paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. The download has no watermark. Review each view against the item you sell before running an ad.

faq.q: Why keep the same background for every side?
faq.a: A shared backdrop keeps the gallery consistent, so buyers can focus on the product shape and its details.

faq.q: What if I have no photo of the back or top?
faq.a: Photograph that side and upload it. Do not present an invented port, button, or feature as a real product detail.

steps.prompt: Front and back of the speaker on one plain background, with the port left as it was photographed.
